spans.s: SK0123 मेद धातु meda dhātu The fourth Dhātu among seven Dhātus of the body, whose function is to provide Snehana. It is dominant of Jala and Pṛthvī Mahābhūtas. Designative of adipose tissue and other lipids in the body.
AF1256 मेदःकल्पं रक्तं medaḥkalpaṁ raktaṁ Blood with the color of fat
AF1260 मेदुर इच्छा medura icchā Desire to take fatty items
AF1258 मेदोदक सन्निभं medodaka sannibhaṁ Resembles the color of washings of fat
AF1259 मेदोदकोपमं medodakopamaṁ Resembles the color of washings of fat
AF1261 मेद्य इच्छा medya icchā Desire to take fatty items
